_README: OWNER RULINGS ON SPECIES SKIN COLOUR. One entry per species he has actually ruled on.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS -- owner, 2026-09-20, verbatim: 'I definitely have said this
before. Please make it stick this time, record it.'
He had ruled Ugnaught on 2026-09-17 ('Make it dull pink for Ugnaught. Ruling from
canon from movies.') and the ruling WAS applied to the def. It still failed to stick,
because the only place it was written down was a git commit message. Nothing reads a
commit message. So:
- design/RimStarWars/canon_references/ugnaught/description.md kept its '## ruling'
section reading '(empty -- owner has not reviewed this race yet)', which was
false for three days;
- the entry went on arguing the pink was wrong, and on 2026-09-20 an agent
'corrected' that entry's provenance without noticing a ruling had settled it.
THE RULE: a ruling here OUTRANKS canon, the canon_references library, an infobox and
any measurement. He is ruling on what the species looks like in OUR game. Canon is
the default, not the authority, and it loses to him every time.
HOW IT IS ENFORCED: src/RimMandrake/Utils/selftest_species_skin_rulings.py reads this
file and asserts the SHIPPED xenotype def carries every required gene and none of the
forbidden ones. It runs in the normal run_selftests.py sweep. A future correctness
pass that 'fixes' a ruled species back toward canon fails the suite immediately.
ADDING ONE: record his words verbatim in owner_said. Never paraphrase a ruling, and
never add an entry for a value he has not actually said.

rulings.owner_said: Make it dull pink for Ugnaught. Ruling from canon from movies.
note: Canon genuinely contradicts itself here and he cut the knot from the films.
The canon infobox says 'varying shades of pink' cited to The Empire Strikes
Back, and the starwars.com Databank agrees -- both first-hand canon
(RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-20). But the infobox's own live-action image, Kuiil from
The Mandalorian, reads dun grey-brown. He ruled dull pink. That ends it.
DO NOT re-open this on the strength of the image.

rulings.owner_said: Umbaran too, greyish skin with a faint blue tone.
note: He said he had ruled this before too. The def shipped Outland_Skin_PaleBlue +
Outland_Skin_PaleAzure, fitted at f60d197b0 (2026-09-17) to the canon infobox's
'Pale and bluish'. His ruling is NARROWER than the infobox: grey dominant, blue
as a faint tone. RSW_Skin_GreyBlue is (158,163,172) -- 14 points of blue lift,
Lavender is forbidden for a separate reason and both agree: the words 'lavender'
and 'violet' appear NOWHERE in the canon article (RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-20). It was
only ever our own agent's read of one painted illustration.

'Infobox skin color is blue only'. RE-VERIFIED 2026-09-20 against the canon
infobox wikitext: it carries TWO values, blue AND orange, orange cited to
